title: Old part sales get no log history, and the work order log is unchanged
custom_preconds:
1. Sign in as an Owner/Admin user. That role holds every permission, including Part sales -> Create & Edit.
  2. A part sale started before the release and a split made before the release: in top menu Parts -> Part Sales, open the oldest sales in the list (created before the Founder Mode release reached this build, e.g. dated Sep 30, 2026 or earlier; ask the QA lead for the release date if unsure). A service work order with Split from / Split to entries: top menu Work Orders, open a work order, tick one of its lines and use Split on it.
custom_steps:
1. Open the pre-release part sale, open the menu ( ... ) at the top of the parts list -> Audit Log, and in the Part Sale Log look for a Created entry.
  2. Open the pre-release split and look for a Split from / Split to pair.
  3. Open a service work order's log and read its Split from / Split to entries.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The pre-release part sale has no Created entry and the pre-release split has no Split from / Split to pair - nothing is backfilled.
  • The service work order's log is unchanged: its Split from and Split to entries read exactly as before, without a linked number.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667 (Founder Mode Batch #1); story SV-10265 (Read the part sale log, and a menu that stops putting Delete first); Part Sales Update v1 PRD (Confluence 867434569), Story 4; design canvas boards S4_*; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-N5: “Nothing is backfilled. A part sale started before the release has no Created entry, and a split made before the release has no Split from or Split to pair”
  • S4-N6: “A service work order's log is unchanged. Its Split from and Split to entries read exactly as they did, without a linked number”

Last checked against build v26.40.7-7ffda69 on 10/5/2026.
